messages:
erin: Heads-up—following the RFC, want to propose a compact plan to consolidate API key bindings so runtime checks are simpler across org/project boundaries. Thoughts?
patrick: +1. We still need to decide whether bindings are encoded in the token (prefix) or resolved via a lookup service.
soumya: leaning lookup service. Prefixes are fast but leak metadata and make rotation hard.
erin: Agreed on leakage. But lookup adds infra + latency. Can we do a hybrid? short prefix for coarse routing + lookup for final authz?
lia: hybrid seems reasonable. Example: prefix 'rwd:o:123' routes to org lane, then runtime fetches exact RBAC. Keeps network hop local for fast rejects.
patrick: Implementation detail: if we do prefix -> routing, client-side SDK needs to be backward-compatible with legacy keys. Migration strategy?
soumya: Migration: 1) accept both variants, 2) issue new keys with prefix, 3) after N months throw deprecation warning, 4) rotate old keys off. Minimal app changes.
erin: Also need to define key format. Proposal: `rwd:o:<orgid>:p:<projid>:<shortid>` where projid optional. Use base36 shortid so tokens stay short.
lia: Concern: exposing org/project IDs in plaintext can be social-engineering vector. Could we HMAC the id portion with a signing key? Then prefix still usable but not trivial to read.
soumya: HMAC sounds fine. Runtime can validate HMAC w/o lookup; if valid, skip DB. That reduces lookup for most calls. If HMAC fails, fall back to lookup.
patrick: Tradeoff: HMAC requires key rotation and synced signing keys across runtimes. Ops burden but tolerable.
erin: On RBAC mapping: do we attach roles to key or derive roles from principal (service/user) + resource group? Prefer deriving from identity to avoid stale role blobs on keys.
lia: +1. Keys are bearer tokens; storing roles on keys forces reissuance when policies change. Derive at eval time.
soumya: Runtime policy evaluation needs to be fast. Plan: cache policy blobs per org, invalidated by webhook from IAM when policy changes. Cache TTL short (30s) but invalidation immediate for admin flows.
erin: For legacy keys without prefix, route them to a compatibility lane that does a full lookup (no HMAC). We'll log counts and owners.
infra-bot: deploy:auth-proxy v2 queued — will add HMAC validation endpoint and compatibility routing. ETA staging tomorrow.
patrick: Action items: erin to draft key format + HMAC spec; soumya to sketch cache/invalidation design; lia to write migration timeline + customer comms.
erin: I'll draft and put RFC follow-up doc in drive, link here when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
soumya: fine to start canary on internal tenants only. We should measure p95 added latency (target <2ms).
lia: also add telemetry for key-format detection so we can chart migration progress.
erin: ok, will include telemetry metrics in the RFC follow-up. Closing thread for now.
